definitions.short: Japhia , the name of a Canaanite, an Israelite, and a place in Palestine
definitions.full: H3309. Yaphia יָפִיעַ proper name, person and location 1. masculine person (compare Sabean יפעאל Hal 150 ) — a. a king of Lachish Josh 10:3 , ᵐ5 Ιεφθα , A ᵐ5 L Ιαφ ( α ) ιε . b. a son of David 2Sam 5:15 ( ᵐ5 Ιεφιες , ᵐ5 L Ναφεθ ) = 1Chr 3:7 ( ᵐ5 Ιανουε A Ιαφιε , ᵐ5 L Αχικαμ ) = 14:6 ( ᵐ5 Ιανουου , A Ιαφιε , ᵐ5 L Ιαβεγ ). 2. proper name, of a location on border of Zebulun Josh 19:12 , perhaps = modern Yâfa , 1/2 hour from Nazareth, Rob BR ii. 343 f , but ᵐ5 Φαγγαι , Ιαφαψαὶ ᵐ5 L Ιαφφιε.
